senses.gloss: f.(b. h. כְּהֻנָּה; v. כֹּהֵן)priesthood, priestly privileges; priestly community.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Middot 1:8">Midd. I, 8</cite>, a. fr. <he>פרחי כ׳</he> young priests (novices).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:1:22">Y. Ber. III, 6ᵃ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 7:1:6">Y. Naz. VII, 56ᵃ</cite> top <he>אין כ׳ היום</he> there is no priesthood to-day (the laws for priests are suspended on the day of Rabbi’s funeral).
<cite ref="Tosefta Challah 2:7">Tosef. Ḥall. II, 7</cite>, a. fr. <he>כ״ד מתנות כ׳</he> twenty-four gifts of priesthood (priestly prerogatives).
<cite ref="Ketubot 14a:4">Keth. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>כשרה לכ׳</he> fit to marry into the priesthood; a. v. fr.
